name: Xperia miro

Network.Technology: GSM GPRS/EDGE 850, 900, 1800, 1900, UMTS HSPA 900, 2100 (global except Americas), UMTS HSPA 850, 1900, 2100 (Americas)

Body.Other: SensMe, TrackID, Sony Entertainment Networks – Music and Video Unlimited*

Platform.Operating system: Android 4.0 "Ice Cream Sandwich", Unofficial upgrades to Android 4.1 "Jelly Bean" (CyanogenMod 10), Android 4.4 "KitKat" (CyanogenMod 11)
